About Wafa Travel and Tour

Helping You Reach the Places That Matter

Wafa Travel and Tour is a Pakistan-based travel agency that aims to help travelers explore destinations and request Hajj, Umrah and other travel services conveniently. From a spiritual journey to a family holiday, we want planning to feel clear, personal and stress-free.

  • Air ticket & flight booking requests
  • Hajj & Umrah request assistance
  • Tours, hotels & transport help

FAQ

Good to Know

Is my booking confirmed when I submit a form?

No. A form only prepares a request message. Every request is subject to confirmation by the agency.

Does this website store my details?

No. This demo form does not save anything in a database. It opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message that you choose to send.

Where can I see prices and fares?

Prices and fares change often, so they are shared by the agency on request after you send your details.

Can you help with visas and travel insurance?

Visa processing and travel insurance assistance are listed among our services. Ask our team about your destination and requirements.

Privacy Policy (Demo)

Sample privacy notice for this demo. The agency should replace it with its own reviewed policy before going live.

What we collect

The forms collect only what you type (name, WhatsApp number, travel details).

How it is used

Your details are placed in a WhatsApp message that you choose to send to the agency. This demo does not store form data in a database.

Sharing

After you send the message, it is handled by WhatsApp and the agency under their own policies.
